capabilities.name: Record Everything Simple Mode
capabilities.notes: Default UI records broad telemetry without requiring route/Arduino/task selection.

capabilities.name: Polling input capture
capabilities.scriptExposure: context input summaries and analyzer artifacts
capabilities.notes: Captures mouse/keyboard/window context and joins to telemetry.

capabilities.name: Coordinate alignment
capabilities.notes: Client inverse DPI transform is proven in menu/route recordings.

capabilities.name: Menu interactions and row geometry
capabilities.notes: Menu snapshots are paired with selections; missing row geometry is no longer a hard route failure.

capabilities.name: Target match quality
capabilities.notes: Strong/medium target tiers support traversal and menu diagnostics; hover/menu identity now rejects unrelated nearby geometry through targetAssociation diagnostics.

capabilities.name: Woodcutting target aim geometry recovery
capabilities.scriptExposure: advisory through target_match_quality geometry and human_click_profile landing summaries
capabilities.notes: Preserved nearby Tree candidates can now provide aimPoint geometry for hover/menu-resolved Chop down clicks; Tree clickbox/hull geometry remains unavailable in the validated fixture.

capabilities.name: Human click and camera profile
capabilities.scriptExposure: get_human_click_profile, get_task_click_profile, click_landing_profile context need, executor handoff
capabilities.notes: Aggregates target-relative click variance, hover/menu evidence, camera segments, mouse path, and imperfect successful clicks across Record Everything recordings.

capabilities.name: Human-profile-informed click planning
capabilities.scriptExposure: get_click_planning_context, get_human_click_plan, get_next_click_plan, context need click_plan, execute_next_action --dry-run-click-plan
capabilities.notes: Produces bounded advisory click plans that compare center clicks with profile-informed aim offsets while preserving readiness, hover/menu, route, banking, and inventory gates.

capabilities.name: Bot eval runner
capabilities.scriptExposure: bot_eval_runner.py --task woodcutting_loop supports replay, preflight, live smoke, and guarded live action
capabilities.notes: Live action delegates readiness/recovery/execution to existing canonical modules and must not silently downgrade to dry-run.

capabilities.name: Loaded-scene recovery
capabilities.notes: Recovery owns loaded-scene proof, Start Game relaunch classification, recovery state-machine artifacts, and fail-closed blockers.

capabilities.name: Input geometry resolver
capabilities.scriptExposure: bot_eval_runner.py --check-input-geometry; live readiness inputGeometry; executor pre-click geometry gate
capabilities.notes: Resolves plugin/file/window geometry, performs bounded RuneLite focus/visibility repair, verifies screen/client/canvas transforms, and fails closed before gameplay input when geometry is stale or unsafe.

capabilities.name: Woodcutting lifecycle
capabilities.scriptExposure: context_service woodcutting lifecycle and task evidence variables
capabilities.notes: Logs, animation, click/menu, and target depletion are summarized when present.

capabilities.name: Woodcutting loop lifecycle
capabilities.notes: Combines woodcutting, banking, route, interruption, combat, and human-profile artifacts into current task phase and next expected phase.

capabilities.name: Combat state and interruption lifecycle
capabilities.notes: Direct mugger fixture proves combat_state preservation, hitsplats, HP change, actor death, and task resume. Older interrupted woodcutting remains useful for unknown-cause WARN behavior.

capabilities.name: Combat damage summary
capabilities.scriptExposure: get_combat_damage_summary, get_damage_taken, get_damage_dealt, get_primary_opponent, did_take_damage, did_deal_damage
capabilities.notes: Computes compact damage taken/dealt, primary opponent, HP delta, actor death, and task resume from preserved combat_state hitsplats and interactions.

capabilities.name: Traversal lifecycle
capabilities.scriptExposure: context route summary and route monitor
capabilities.notes: Uses routeSegments as primary route model; raw steps are debug evidence.

capabilities.name: Route templates and variants
capabilities.notes: Templates compare routeSegments, allow navigation-support substitutions, and preserve variants.

capabilities.name: Route monitor and persistent route history
capabilities.scriptExposure: route_monitor context needs and history artifacts
capabilities.notes: Template path resolution and arrival gating are fixed; live stale data is not trusted.

capabilities.name: Route demonstration guide
capabilities.notes: Live proposal consumes demonstrated guide progress before stale route monitor fallback and blocks full-inventory Tree fallbacks.

capabilities.name: Banking lifecycle
capabilities.notes: Direct bank_ui plus inventory and bank container deltas produce PASS when available.

capabilities.name: bank_ui preservation
capabilities.notes: Record Everything preserves bank_ui snapshots from the plugin snapshot endpoint.

capabilities.name: Bank container delta
capabilities.notes: Plugin exports compact future delta; analyzer can recover historical snapshot diffs.

capabilities.name: Context banking and route needs
capabilities.notes: Compact context avoids dumping giant raw arrays by default.

capabilities.name: Task script banking API
capabilities.scriptExposure: script helpers and runtime evidence variables
capabilities.notes: Scripts do not need to parse banking_lifecycle.json directly.

capabilities.name: Arduino probe/mapping evidence
capabilities.notes: Arduino is optional for Record Everything; map_only avoids duplicate live clicks.

capabilities.name: Live mirror
capabilities.notes: Useful for validation; not required for normal recordings.

decisions.decision: Record Everything Simple Mode is the default workflow.
decisions.reason: Record broadly first; analyzer decides what matters later.

decisions.decision: Arduino is optional for recording and route monitoring.
decisions.reason: Human recordings must still be useful without hardware.

decisions.decision: map_only is the safe default when Arduino mapping evidence is enabled.
Route templates compare routeSegments, not raw clicks.
decisions.reason: Raw clicks include support/review evidence and normal route variants.

decisions.decision: Door/Open is optional for Bank_to_Woodcutting_area revision 3.
decisions.reason: Walk here Large door can be navigation support; required segments are start, walk, stair, walk, arrival.

decisions.decision: Banking must consume direct bank_ui when available.
decisions.reason: Inventory-only inference is useful but weaker than direct widget/container evidence.

decisions.decision: Useful telemetry should not stay recorder-only when scripts need it.
decisions.reason: Promote through analyzer, context_service, MCP where useful, and task_script_api.

decisions.decision: Human click/camera behavior is a profile reference, not an execution shortcut.
decisions.reason: Use it to shape tolerances and recommendations while preserving existing guarded input paths.

decisions.decision: Human-profile click planning is dry-run/advisory until replay validation proves it.
decisions.reason: Target readiness, hover/menu proof, and task state gates must remain stronger than a profile offset.

decisions.decision: Project state belongs in docs/knowledge and telemetry-viewer/knowledge_base.
decisions.reason: Do not rely on chat memory alone.

decisions.decision: Live bot recovery uses liveStartCommand or discovered Jagex quick launch, not devStartCommand.
decisions.reason: Gradle launches are useful for plugin development but do not prove launcher-authenticated loaded-scene access.
